sentences.quote: We believe that tomorrow will be different.

analysis.translationLiteral: 我们相信明天将会不同。
analysis.translationNatural: 我们总以为，明天会不一样。
analysis.structMarkup: 【We】 _believe_ {that tomorrow will be different}.
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓 + 宾语从句（that 引导）

components.note: that 引导，从句为主系表

clauses: that 引导宾语从句，作 believe 的宾语。
analysis.paragraphRole: 点出人们自我安慰式的信念，为下一句的转折蓄势。

sentences.quote: We believe that we will be different tomorrow; but in doing so, we prioritize our current mood over the consequences of our inaction for the future self.

analysis.translationLiteral: 我们相信明天的我们会不同；但这样做时，我们把当下的心情优先于我们的不作为给未来自我带来的后果。
analysis.translationNatural: 总觉得「明天的我会变」；可正因这么想，我们只顾眼前心情，把日后要吞的苦果搁到一边。
analysis.structMarkup: 【We】 _believe_ {that we will be different tomorrow}; but in doing so, 【we】 _prioritize_ ~our current mood~ over the consequences of our inaction for the future self.
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓宾从句；分号后为 but 连接的并列分句

components.part: that we will be different tomorrow

components.note: 分号后分句主语，指同一群人
prioritize A over B 表示把 A 放在 B 之前
与 the consequences 形成对比

clauses: that 引导宾语从句，作 believe 的宾语。

phrases.meaning: 把 A 看得比 B 更重要
phrases.usage: over 表示优先于；也可说 put A before B。
phrases.example: She prioritizes health over work. 她把健康看得比工作重。

pitfalls: prioritize our current mood over the consequences 是第 42 题「优先考虑当下心境」的定位句。
analysis.paragraphRole: 点明决策偏差，E 段整体对应第 42 题。

sentences.quote: Understanding our procrastination (拖延) through the lens of the present and future selves, we're left with three possible solutions: The first is to force your future self to do whatever your present self doesn't want to do.

analysis.translationLiteral: 通过当下自我与未来自我的透镜理解我们的拖延之后，我们剩下三种可能的解决办法：第一种是强迫未来的自己去做当下自己不想做的事。
analysis.translationNatural: 用这套框架看拖延，出路有三条：一是逼未来的自己，把现在不想干的活儿干掉。
analysis.structMarkup: (Understanding our procrastination (拖延) through the lens of the present and future selves), 【we】're _left_ with ~three possible solutions~: The first is to force your future self to do whatever your present self doesn't want to do.
analysis.structureSummary: 现在分词状语 + 主谓（被动）+ 宾语；冒号后为主系表

components.part: Understanding our procrastination (拖延) through the lens of the present and future selves

components.note: be left with 意为「剩下、落到手里」

clauses: whatever your present self doesn't want to do 是宾语从句，作 do 的宾语。
analysis.paragraphRole: F 段总起三条对策，并给出第一条。

sentences.quote: The second is to convince your present self that your future self is, in fact, still you.

analysis.translationLiteral: 第二种是让当下的自己相信，未来的自己事实上仍然是你。
analysis.translationNatural: 二是说服现在的我：未来的那个，其实还是我。
analysis.structMarkup: 【The second】 _is_ ~to convince your present self that your future self is, in fact, still you~.
analysis.structureSummary: 主系表 + 不定式作表语（内含宾语从句）

components.part: to convince your present self that your future self is, in fact, still you
components.note: 不定式作表语；convince sb that... 为固定结构

clauses: that 引导宾语从句，作 convince 的宾语。
analysis.paragraphRole: 给出第二条对策：让当下的自己认同未来的自己。

sentences.quote: If the central problem is that we think of our future selves as other people, it follows that trying to identify more closely with our future selves will encourage us to make better long-term decisions.

analysis.translationLiteral: 如果核心问题是我们把未来的自己想成别人，那么由此可得：更紧密地认同未来的自己，将鼓励我们做出更好的长期决定。
analysis.translationNatural: 既然病根在于把未来的我当外人，那么只要多认同他一点，长期决策自然会更靠谱。
analysis.structMarkup: {If the central problem is that we think of our future selves as other people}, 【it】 _follows_ {that trying to identify more closely with our future selves will encourage us to make better long-term decisions}.
analysis.structureSummary: if 条件状语从句 + 主句（it follows that...）

components.part: If the central problem is that we think of our future selves as other people
components.note: if 引导条件；从句中含 that 表语从句
it follows that 中的形式主语

components.part: that trying to identify more closely with our future selves will encourage us to make better long-term decisions
components.note: 从句主语是动名词短语 trying to identify...

clauses: that we think of... 是表语从句，说明 the central problem 的内容。
it follows that... 中 that 引导真正的主语从句。
pitfalls: 动名词短语 trying to identify... 作主语，谓语用单数 will encourage。
本句是第 39 题「把未来自我视为自己有助长期决策」的定位句。
analysis.paragraphRole: 论证第二条对策的合理性，F 段对应第 39 题。

sentences.quote: In a follow-up study, Hershfield wanted to explore ways to bridge the disconnect between the present and future selves and encourage people to save more for retirement.

analysis.translationLiteral: 在一项后续研究中，赫什菲尔德想探索弥合当下自我与未来自我之间脱节的办法，并鼓励人们为退休多存钱。
analysis.translationNatural: 后续实验里，他想试试能不能把两个「我」拉近，让人更愿意为养老存钱。
analysis.structMarkup: (In a follow-up study), 【Hershfield】 _wanted_ ~to explore ways to bridge the disconnect between the present and future selves and encourage people to save more for retirement~.
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓宾 + 不定式作后置定语与并列目的

components.note: want to explore 表示研究意图

components.part: to explore ways to bridge the disconnect between the present and future selves and encourage people to save more for retirement
components.note: 不定式作 wanted 的宾语，内含两个并列动作

analysis.paragraphRole: G 段引入验证实验：用虚拟化身拉近两个自我。

sentences.quote: He and his team took photos of study participants, and then used image processing to visually age their faces.

analysis.translationLiteral: 他和团队给研究参与者拍了照片，然后用图像处理让他们的脸在视觉上变老。
analysis.translationNatural: 团队先给受试者拍照，再用图像处理把脸「催老」。
analysis.structMarkup: 【He and his team】 _took_ ~photos of study participants~, and then used image processing (to visually age their faces).
analysis.structureSummary: 并列谓语（took / used）+ 不定式目的状语

components.note: 不定式作目的状语；age 在此作动词

pitfalls: age 在此是动词，意为「使变老」，不是名词「年龄」。
analysis.paragraphRole: 说明实验操作一：拍照并做老化处理。

sentences.quote: Participants were then placed in a virtual reality setting where they could look into a mirror and see their aged selves looking back at them.

analysis.translationLiteral: 参与者随后被置于一个虚拟现实场景中，在那里他们可以照镜子，看到变老的自己正回望着他们。
analysis.translationNatural: 接着把受试者放进虚拟现实，让他们照镜子，看见老年的自己也在看着自己。
analysis.structMarkup: 【Participants】 _were then placed_ (in a virtual reality setting) where they could look into a mirror and see their aged selves looking back at them.
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓（被动）+ 地点状语 + 定语从句（where 引导）

components.note: 地点状语，后接 where 定语从句

clauses: where 引导定语从句，修饰 a virtual reality setting。
analysis.paragraphRole: 说明实验操作二：在虚拟现实里看见年老的自己。

sentences.quote: Participants who saw their aged selves said they would save 30% more of their salary for retirement than the control group.

analysis.translationLiteral: 看到年老的自己的参与者说，他们愿意把工资中比对照组多 30% 的部分存作退休金。
analysis.translationNatural: 看过老年版自己的那组人表示，愿意拿出比对照组多三成工资来存养老钱。
analysis.structMarkup: 【Participants who saw their aged selves】 _said_ {they would save 30% more of their salary for retirement than the control group}.
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓 + 宾语从句（省略 that）+ 定语从句

components.part: Participants who saw their aged selves
components.note: who 引导定语从句缩小范围
后接省略 that 的宾语从句

components.part: they would save 30% more of their salary for retirement than the control group
components.note: would 表示假设情境下的意愿

clauses: who saw their aged selves 是定语从句，修饰 Participants。
they would save... 是省略 that 的宾语从句。
pitfalls: 30% more ... than the control group 是第 45 题「愿为晚年多存钱」的定位句。
analysis.paragraphRole: 给出实验结果，G 段对应第 45 题。

sentences.quote: Whatever your long-term goals may be—getting in better shape, launching your own business, writing a book—thinking about your deadline in terms of days rather than months or years can help you wrap your mind around how close the future really is.

analysis.translationLiteral: 无论你的长期目标是什么——练出好身材、创业、写书——用「天」而不是「月」或「年」去想截止期限，能帮你理解未来到底有多近。
analysis.translationNatural: 不管是减肥、创业还是写书，把截止期按「天」算而不是按「年」算，你才会真切感到未来其实近在眼前。
analysis.structMarkup: {Whatever your long-term goals may be—getting in better shape, launching your own business, writing a book}—【thinking about your deadline in terms of days rather than months or years】 _can help_ ~you~ wrap your mind around how close the future really is.
analysis.structureSummary: Whatever 让步状语从句 + 动名词短语作主语 + 主谓宾

components.part: Whatever your long-term goals may be—getting in better shape, launching your own business, writing a book
components.note: Whatever 引导让步，破折号内为举例

components.part: thinking about your deadline in terms of days rather than months or years

clauses: Whatever 引导让步状语从句；how close the future really is 是宾语从句，作 around 的宾语。
analysis.paragraphRole: H 段给出一条实用建议：用「天」而不是「年」来感知截止期。

sentences.quote: The third solution is to forget about your future self and use your present self's love of instant gratification (满足感) to your advantage.

analysis.translationLiteral: 第三种办法是忘掉未来的自己，并把当下的自己对即时满足的喜爱变成你的优势。
analysis.translationNatural: 第三招干脆别管未来的我，顺势利用「现在的我就想马上爽」这一天性。
analysis.structMarkup: 【The third solution】 _is_ ~to forget about your future self and use your present self's love of instant gratification (满足感) to your advantage~.
analysis.structureSummary: 主系表 + 并列不定式作表语

components.note: 承接 F 段列出的三条办法

components.part: to forget about your future self and use your present self's love of instant gratification (满足感) to your advantage
components.note: 两个并列不定式由 and 连接

analysis.paragraphRole: I 段提出第三条对策：顺应而非对抗即时满足。

sentences.quote: While the two tactics (手段) above can be effective in making better long-term choices, in the end, you're still struggling against human nature.

analysis.translationLiteral: 虽然上面两种手段在做出更好的长期选择时可能有效，但到头来，你仍然在跟人性较劲。
analysis.translationNatural: 前两招虽然管用，说到底还是在跟人的天性拧着来。
analysis.structMarkup: {While the two tactics (手段) above can be effective in making better long-term choices}, (in the end), 【you】're still _struggling_ against human nature.
analysis.structureSummary: While 让步状语从句 + 主谓

components.part: While the two tactics (手段) above can be effective in making better long-term choices

components.note: 与 are 构成现在进行时

clauses: While 引导让步状语从句，与主句形成转折。
analysis.paragraphRole: 指出前两条对策的局限，为第三条铺垫。

sentences.quote: Our brains are hard-wired for instant gratification.

analysis.translationLiteral: 我们的大脑被硬连线为追求即时满足。
analysis.translationNatural: 人脑天生就偏爱立刻能到手的满足感。
analysis.structMarkup: 【Our brains】 _are_ ~hard-wired for instant gratification~.
analysis.structureSummary: 主系表

components.note: 复数主语，系动词用 are
过去分词形容词化，表示与生俱来的倾向

phrases.meaning: 天生就倾向于、本能地会
phrases.usage: hard-wired 原指硬件固连，喻指难以改变的天性。
phrases.example: Humans are hard-wired for social connection. 人天生就需要社会联结。

pitfalls: 本句是第 36 题「大脑天生由基因决定追求即时欲望」的直接依据。
analysis.paragraphRole: 给出第三条对策的前提，I 段对应第 36 题。

sentences.quote: Instead of fighting your present self's need for immediate rewards, why not use it to your advantage?

analysis.translationLiteral: 与其对抗当下的自己对即时奖励的需求，为什么不把它变成你的优势呢？
analysis.translationNatural: 既然压不住「现在就要奖励」的念头，何不干脆借力打力？
analysis.structMarkup: (Instead of fighting your present self's need for immediate rewards), why not _use_ ~it~ to your advantage?
analysis.structureSummary: 介词短语状语 + 反问句（why not + 动词原形）

components.part: Instead of fighting your present self's need for immediate rewards

components.note: why not 后接动词原形

pitfalls: why not 后接动词原形，不加 to。
analysis.paragraphRole: 用反问把第三条对策说得更明确。

sentences.quote: When most of us set goals, we focus on long-term results we want to see—e.g., losing weight, getting a promotion, retiring in comfort, etc. While those visions of our future selves can be inspiring, when it comes to actually doing the day-to-day work, it may be more effective to reframe activities in terms of their immediate, or at least very near-term, rewards.

analysis.translationLiteral: 当我们多数人设定目标时，我们聚焦于想看到的长期结果——例如减重、升职、舒适地退休，等等。
analysis.translationNatural: 大多数人定目标时盯的都是长远结果：瘦下来、升职、体面退休之类。
analysis.structMarkup: {When most of us set goals}, 【we】 _focus on_ ~long-term results we want to see~—e.g., losing weight, getting a promotion, retiring in comfort, etc.
analysis.structureSummary: 时间状语从句 + 主谓宾（含省略关系代词的定语从句）

components.part: When most of us set goals
long-term results we want to see
components.note: we want to see 是省略 that 的定语从句

clauses: we want to see 是省略关系代词 that 的定语从句，修饰 long-term results。
analysis.paragraphRole: 指出人们定目标时的通病：只盯长期结果。

sentences.quote: Take writing this article, for instance.

analysis.translationLiteral: 以写这篇文章为例。
analysis.translationNatural: 就拿我写这篇文章来说吧。
analysis.structMarkup: _Take_ ~writing this article~, (for instance).
analysis.structureSummary: 祈使句（主谓宾 + 插入语）
analysis.paragraphRole: J 段以作者自己写稿为例，转入研究证据。

sentences.quote: It's easy for me to imagine how amazing it will feel at the end of the workday to have this article done.

analysis.translationLiteral: 对我来说，想象在工作日结束时把这篇文章写完会有多棒，是容易的。
analysis.translationNatural: 我很容易就能想象：一天收工时稿子写完了，那感觉多爽。
analysis.structMarkup: 【It】's ~easy~ (for me) to imagine how amazing it will feel at the end of the workday to have this article done.
analysis.structureSummary: it 形式主语 + 主系表 + 不定式（内含宾语从句）
clauses: how amazing it will feel... 是宾语从句，作 imagine 的宾语。
pitfalls: It's 是 It is 的缩写；句中 it 出现两次，后一个 it 指代「写完文章」这件事。
analysis.paragraphRole: 说明「想象完成后的成就感」很容易。

sentences.quote: This isn't just my opinion.

analysis.translationLiteral: 这不只是我的个人看法。
analysis.translationNatural: 不过这可不光是我的一家之言。
analysis.structMarkup: 【This】 _isn't_ ~just my opinion~.
analysis.structureSummary: 主系表（否定）

components.note: is not 的缩写，否定式

analysis.paragraphRole: 转折：下面有研究支撑，不只是个人感觉。

sentences.quote: Research partners Kaitlin Woolley of Cornell University and Ayelet Fishbach of the University of Chicago have made a career out of studying the differences between the goals that people achieve and the ones that fall to the wayside.

analysis.translationLiteral: 康奈尔大学的 Kaitlin Woolley 与芝加哥大学的 Ayelet Fishbach 这对研究搭档，以研究「人们达成的目标」与「被搁置的目标」之间的差异为业。
analysis.translationNatural: 康奈尔的凯特琳·伍利和芝加哥大学的阿耶莱特·菲什巴赫，长期专门研究：哪些目标能坚持下来，哪些半途而废。
analysis.structMarkup: 【Research partners Kaitlin Woolley of Cornell University and Ayelet Fishbach of the University of Chicago】 _have made_ ~a career out of studying the differences between the goals that people achieve and the ones that fall to the wayside~.
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓宾 + 两个并列定语从句

components.part: Research partners Kaitlin Woolley of Cornell University and Ayelet Fishbach of the University of Chicago
components.note: 并列人名作主语，谓语用 have

components.part: a career out of studying the differences between the goals that people achieve and the ones that fall to the wayside
components.note: make a career out of doing 意为「以……为业」

clauses: that people achieve 是定语从句，修饰 the goals。
that fall to the wayside 是定语从句，修饰 the ones。
analysis.paragraphRole: 引入两位研究者及其研究主题，为 K 段的结论铺垫。

sentences.quote: "In one study, we asked people online about the goals they set at the beginning of the year.

analysis.translationLiteral: 「在一项研究中，我们在网上询问人们他们在年初设定的目标。
analysis.translationNatural: 「有一项研究里，我们在线问了大家年初定下的目标。
analysis.structMarkup: "(In one study), 【we】 _asked_ ~people online~ about the goals they set at the beginning of the year.
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓宾 + 省略关系代词的定语从句（引语开头）

components.note: ask sb about sth 结构

clauses: they set at the beginning of the year 是省略 that 的定语从句，修饰 the goals。
pitfalls: 整段是直接引语，句首引号一直延续到段末才闭合。
analysis.paragraphRole: K 段开始引用研究者原话，介绍研究设计。

sentences.quote: Most people set goals to achieve delayed, long-term benefits, such as career advancement, debt repayment, or improved health.

analysis.translationLiteral: 大多数人设定目标是为了获得延迟的长期收益，例如职业晋升、还清债务或健康改善。
analysis.translationNatural: 多数人的目标都是些要等很久才见效的事：升职、还债、身体变好。
analysis.structMarkup: 【Most people】 _set_ ~goals~ (to achieve delayed, long-term benefits), such as career advancement, debt repayment, or improved health.
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓宾 + 不定式目的状语 + 举例

components.note: set goals 意为「设定目标」

analysis.paragraphRole: 说明多数目标指向延迟的长期收益。

sentences.quote: We asked these individuals how enjoyable it was to pursue their goal, as well as how important their goal was.

analysis.translationLiteral: 我们问这些人追求目标有多令人愉快，同时也问他们的目标有多重要。
analysis.translationNatural: 我们既问「追这个目标有多好玩」，也问「它对你有多重要」。
analysis.structMarkup: 【We】 _asked_ ~these individuals~ {how enjoyable it was to pursue their goal}, as well as how important their goal was.
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓 + 两个并列宾语从句

components.part: how enjoyable it was to pursue their goal
components.note: how 引导，it 为形式主语

clauses: how enjoyable... 与 how important... 是两个并列的宾语从句，由 as well as 连接。
analysis.paragraphRole: 说明测量了两个变量：过程的愉悦度与目标的重要度。

sentences.quote: We also asked whether they were still working on their goals two months after setting them.

analysis.translationLiteral: 我们还问了在设定目标两个月后，他们是否仍在为这些目标努力。
analysis.translationNatural: 两个月后我们再追踪：他们还在坚持吗？
analysis.structMarkup: 【We】 _also asked_ {whether they were still working on their goals two months after setting them}.
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓 + 宾语从句（whether 引导）

components.note: also 表示追加一个问题

components.part: whether they were still working on their goals two months after setting them

clauses: whether 引导宾语从句，用陈述语序。
analysis.paragraphRole: 说明追踪指标：两个月后的坚持程度。

sentences.quote: We found that enjoyment predicted people's goal persistence two months after setting the goal far more than how important they rated their goal to be," Woolley said.

analysis.translationLiteral: 「我们发现，愉悦程度对两个月后目标坚持度的预测力，远远超过他们给目标打的重要程度，」伍利说。
analysis.translationNatural: 伍利说：「结果很明显——能不能坚持下去，靠的是过程有多享受，而不是当初觉得它有多重要。」
analysis.structMarkup: 【We】 _found_ {that enjoyment predicted people's goal persistence two months after setting the goal far more than how important they rated their goal to be}," (Woolley said).
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓 + 宾语从句（含 far more than 比较结构）+ 引语后置说明

components.note: 后接 that 从句陈述发现

components.part: that enjoyment predicted people's goal persistence two months after setting the goal far more than how important they rated their goal to be
components.note: far more than 引出比较对象
引语出处说明，置于引语之后

clauses: that 引导宾语从句，作 found 的宾语。
how important they rated their goal to be 是宾语从句，作 than 的比较对象。
pitfalls: enjoyment predicted... far more than how important... 是第 41 题「愉悦而非重要度让人坚持」的直接依据。
analysis.paragraphRole: 给出核心结论，K 段对应第 41 题。

sentences.quote: This pattern held true across a wide variety of goals from exercising to studying to eating healthier foods.

analysis.translationLiteral: 这一模式在从锻炼到学习再到吃得更健康等多种目标中都成立。
analysis.translationNatural: 不管是运动、学习还是健康饮食，这个规律都一样成立。
analysis.structMarkup: 【This pattern】 _held_ true (across a wide variety of goals) from exercising to studying to eating healthier foods.
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓（系表式固定搭配）+ 范围状语

components.note: hold true 意为「成立、适用」

components.part: across a wide variety of goals

analysis.paragraphRole: L 段说明结论具有跨目标类型的普遍性。

sentences.quote: For example, people ate 50% more of a healthy food when directed to focus on the good taste rather than the long-term health benefits.

analysis.translationLiteral: 例如，当被引导去关注好味道而不是长期健康益处时，人们多吃了 50% 的健康食品。
analysis.translationNatural: 比如只让人想着「这东西好吃」，别提「对身体好」，健康食品的摄入量能多出一半。
analysis.structMarkup: (For example), 【people】 _ate_ ~50% more of a healthy food~ (when directed to focus on the good taste rather than the long-term health benefits).
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓宾 + 时间状语（when + 过去分词）

components.part: when directed to focus on the good taste rather than the long-term health benefits
components.note: when + 过去分词，省略 they were

pitfalls: 50% more ... focus on the good taste rather than... 是第 43 题的定位句。
analysis.paragraphRole: 给出食物实验的具体数据，L 段对应第 43 题。

sentences.quote: Other studies have shown a greater uptake of exercise in people who were told to think of the enjoyment of doing the exercise now rather than future health gains.

analysis.translationLiteral: 其他研究显示，在那些被告知去想「现在运动的乐趣」而不是「未来健康收益」的人当中，运动参与度更高。
analysis.translationNatural: 还有研究发现：让人想着「运动当下就挺爽」，比想着「以后身体会更好」更能促使他们动起来。
analysis.structMarkup: 【Other studies】 _have shown_ ~a greater uptake of exercise~ in people who were told to think of the enjoyment of doing the exercise now rather than future health gains.
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓宾 + 定语从句（who 引导）

components.note: uptake 此处意为「接受、参与」

clauses: who were told to think of... 是定语从句，修饰 people。
analysis.paragraphRole: 补充运动领域的旁证，强化「关注当下愉悦」的结论。

sentences.quote: These findings suggest that when it comes to achieving your goals, enjoying the process itself is more important than wanting the long-term benefits.

analysis.translationLiteral: 这些发现表明，谈到实现目标时，享受过程本身比想要长期收益更重要。
analysis.translationNatural: 结论很清楚：想让目标落地，享受过程比惦记长远好处更管用。
analysis.structMarkup: 【These findings】 _suggest_ {that when it comes to achieving your goals, enjoying the process itself is more important than wanting the long-term benefits}.
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓 + 宾语从句（含时间状语从句与动名词主语）

components.part: that when it comes to achieving your goals, enjoying the process itself is more important than wanting the long-term benefits
components.note: 从句主语是动名词 enjoying the process itself

clauses: that 引导宾语从句；when it comes to... 在从句中作时间状语。
pitfalls: 本句是第 38 题「享受过程比追求长期收益更重要」的直接依据。
analysis.paragraphRole: M 段总结研究结论，对应第 38 题。

sentences.quote: In other words, present self trumps (战胜) future self.

analysis.translationLiteral: 换句话说，当下的自己胜过未来的自己。
analysis.translationNatural: 说白了：眼下这个我，压过未来那个我。
analysis.structMarkup: (In other words), 【present self】 _trumps_ (战胜) ~future self~.
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓宾

components.note: trump 作动词，意为「胜过、压倒」

analysis.paragraphRole: 用一句话浓缩全文的核心判断。

sentences.quote: Who says instant gratification has to be a bad thing?

analysis.translationLiteral: 谁说即时满足就一定是件坏事呢？
analysis.translationNatural: 谁规定「马上就爽」一定是坏事？
analysis.structMarkup: 【Who】 _says_ {instant gratification has to be a bad thing}?
analysis.structureSummary: 特殊疑问句（主谓 + 宾语从句）

components.note: 后接省略 that 的宾语从句

components.part: instant gratification has to be a bad thing
components.note: has to 表示「必须、一定」

clauses: instant gratification has to be a bad thing 是省略 that 的宾语从句。
analysis.paragraphRole: 用反问为「即时满足」正名，呼应 I 段第三条对策。

sentences.quote: By all means, set ambitious long-term goals for your future self, but when it comes to actually following through day-to-day, make sure your present self knows what's in it for her too.

analysis.translationLiteral: 务必为未来的自己设定宏大的长期目标，但到了真正日复一日执行时，也要确保当下的自己知道其中有什么是给她的好处。
analysis.translationNatural: 长期目标尽管往大里定，可真要每天坚持，得让「现在的我」也尝到甜头才行。
analysis.structMarkup: (By all means), _set_ ~ambitious long-term goals~ for your future self, but {when it comes to actually following through day-to-day}, _make sure_ your present self knows what's in it for her too.
analysis.structureSummary: 祈使句 + but 并列祈使句（含时间状语从句与宾语从句）

components.part: when it comes to actually following through day-to-day
components.note: when it comes to 后接动名词
后接省略 that 的宾语从句

clauses: what's in it for her 是宾语从句，作 knows 的宾语。
pitfalls: 两句都是祈使句，主语 you 被省略；but 连接两个并列建议。
analysis.paragraphRole: 收束全文：长期目标与即时回报并不矛盾，两者要同时照顾。

questions.stem: Our brains are genetically determined to satisfy immediate desires.
Taken in a practical way, saving for post-work years is like giving money away to others.
Research found that, as regards achievement of one's goals, it is important to focus more on enjoying the process than the long-term benefits.
Regarding our future selves as still being ourselves will help us make better long-term decisions.
Savings rates in America have dropped in recent decades even though people's life expectancy has increased.
Researchers found that enjoyment rather than importance enabled people to persist in their goals.
When making decisions, we give priority to our current frame of mind without thinking much of the consequences.
People ate more of a healthy food when they focused on its good taste instead of its long-term benefits.
As was expected, when people thought of their present selves, their brains were observed to become more active.
Researchers found that participants who saw the images of their aged selves would save more for their later years than those who didn't.

examples: She achieved her goal in two years. 她两年内实现了目标。
Being active improves mood. 保持活跃能改善情绪。
What are my activities and my social network? 我有哪些活动、我的社交圈是什么？
Physical activity improves mood. 身体活动能改善情绪。

lexicon.sense: 实际上、事实上；居然（表出乎意料）
examples: In reality the female actually did most of it. 现实中主要还是女性在做。

lexicon.sense: 任何事物（否定/疑问句常用）
examples: They rarely share anything personal. 他们很少分享私事。

lexicon.sense: 离开、远离；（时间/距离）之外
examples: Parents stare at their phones instead of reading. 家长盯着手机而不读书。
Too much screen time is bad for sleep. 屏幕时间过多对睡眠有害。
His behavior surprised everyone. 他的举止让所有人意外。
I believe he is right. 我认为他是对的。

lexicon.sense: 好处、益处（benefit 的复数）；福利待遇
examples: The benefits of multitasking are clear. 多任务处理的好处很明显。

lexicon.sense: 更好的；更好地（good/well 的比较级）
examples: Sleep is better than more coffee. 睡眠比多喝咖啡更管用。
Our brains cannot truly multitask. 我们的大脑无法真正同时处理多任务。

lexicon.sense: 生意、商业（不可数）；公司（可数）；事、分内事
examples: People in business rely on instincts. 商界人士依赖直觉。
Work is central to his identity. 工作是他自我认同的核心。

lexicon.sense: come 的第三人称单数（来）
examples: With success comes new pressure. 成功带来新的压力。
Give me a concrete example. 给我举个具体例子。
Try to control your temper. 尽量控制住脾气。

lexicon.sense: 当前的（形容词）；水流、电流（名词）
examples: At current rates, change will be slow. 以目前的速度，改变会很慢。
She handles the day-to-day running of the shop. 她负责店铺的日常运营。
Three decades after his retirement he is still famous. 退役三十年后他依然出名。
The train was delayed by snow. 火车因雪延误了。
There are clear differences between the groups. 两组之间有明显差异。
Their experiences were considerably different. 他们的经历相当不同。

lexicon.sense: does not 的缩写（第三人称单数否定）
examples: That doesn't mean it's all good news. 这并不意味着全是好消息。
The task looks easy. 这任务看着简单。

lexicon.sense: eat 的现在分词；饮食（不可数）
examples: Healthy eating starts early. 健康饮食从小开始。

lexicon.sense: 结束、末尾（名词）；结束（动词）
examples: Fame did not decrease with the end of his career. 名气并未随职业生涯结束而减少。
For example, texting and reading coexist. 例如，发短信和读书并存。

lexicon.sense: 锻炼（不可数）；练习、习题（可数）/ 锻炼
examples: Regular exercise improves sleep. 规律锻炼能改善睡眠。

lexicon.sense: exercise 的现在分词（锻炼；行使）
examples: Exercising regularly improves sleep. 规律锻炼能改善睡眠。
In fact, they spend hours changing settings. 事实上他们花数小时修改设置。
Food prices are rising. 食品价格在上涨。

lexicon.sense: 各种食品（food 的复数，指多个种类）
examples: Some foods will simply cost more. 有些食品就是会涨价。

lexicon.sense: find 的过去式与过去分词（发现）；另作独立动词「创建、创办」
examples: Researchers found a clear link. 研究者发现了明确的关联。
The future of food is uncertain. 食物的未来不确定。
As kids get older they write more carefully. 孩子越大写得越小心。

lexicon.sense: get 的现在分词（得到、变得）
examples: They start getting better sleep. 他们开始改善睡眠。

lexicon.sense: 去、走；（go up/down）上升/下降；进行
collocations: there is still some way to go
examples: Satisfaction went down for many women. 许多女性满意度下降。

lexicon.sense: 好的；有益的 / 好处（不可数）
examples: A rich social life is good for health. 丰富社交生活有益健康。

lexicon.sense: 更大的（great 的比较级）；更重大的
examples: The web is replaced in reaction to greater independence. 因为更独立，网络被替换了。

lexicon.sense: 群体、小组（可数）/ 分组（动词）
examples: Studies have shown that social support helps. 研究表明社会支持有帮助。
Social ties affect health. 社会联系影响健康。
They start a healthy diet. 他们开始健康饮食。

lexicon.sense: 帮助（help sb do sth / help with）；帮助（不可数）
examples: Instincts can help you decide fast. 直觉能帮你快速决定。

lexicon.sense: it is 或 it has 的缩写（注意与 its 所有格区分）
examples: It's hard to say. 很难说。

lexicon.sense: 像（介词）；喜欢（动词）；口语连词「像……那样」
examples: Tools like this save time. 这样的工具能省时间。

lexicon.sense: 更长的（long 的比较级）；（no longer）不再
examples: Essays are now six times longer. 现在文章长了六倍。
When you look at today's digital activity... 当你审视当今的数字活动……
General farm management can ease changes. 总体农场管理能缓解变化冲击。

lexicon.sense: mean 的第三人称单数；手段、方法（单复同形）
examples: She argues the data means little. 她认为这些数据意义不大。

lexicon.sense: 需要（情态/实义动词）；需要、需求（名词）
examples: Parents need to set boundaries. 家长需要划定界限。
They are now six times longer. 它们现在长了六倍。

lexicon.sense: participant 的复数，参与者、受试者

examples: It is not, for most teens, a cycle of abuse in most parts. 对多数青少年而言并非如此。

lexicon.sense: 人们（复数集合名词，谓语用复数）；民族（可数）
examples: Most people agree on this point. 多数人同意这一点。
Can a person really be a multitasker? 一个人真的能一心多用吗？
They arrive at the best possible decisions. 他们做出尽可能最好的决定。

lexicon.sense: predict 的过去式/过去分词（预测）；预测的
examples: Losses were predicted early. 损失很早就被预测到。
Loneliness is a significant problem. 孤独是个重要问题。

lexicon.sense: 问题（需回答）；疑问 / 质疑
examples: This seemingly easy question drives the need to understand. 这个看似简单的问题催生了理解的需要。

lexicon.sense: 现实、实际情况（可数/不可数）
examples: In reality, the female did most of the care. 现实中主要是女性在做照护。
They do not really reflect everyday behaviour. 它们并没有真正反映日常行为。
One recent study found a surprising result. 最近一项研究发现了意外的结果。

lexicon.sense: 研究（不可数）；调查 / 研究
examples: A growing body of research supports this. 越来越多的研究支持这一点。

lexicon.sense: 结果（可数）/ 导致（result in）、由……造成（result from）
examples: The result was surprising. 结果令人意外。
The results suggest a clear difference. 结果表明有明显差异。

lexicon.sense: say 的第三人称单数（说）
examples: He says the change is coming. 他说变化正在到来。
We see the same pattern again. 我们又看到了同样的模式。

lexicon.sense: see 的过去分词（被看见）
examples: This has long been seen as normal. 这长期被视为正常。

lexicon.sense: 设置、放（动词）；一套（名词）；固定的（形容词）
examples: Parents need to set firm boundaries. 家长需要设定明确界限。
Men reported similar levels of enjoyment. 男性报告的享受程度相近。

lexicon.sense: 仍然、还（副词）；静止的、平静的（形容词）
examples: The gap is still wide. 差距仍然很大。

lexicon.sense: 研究（study 的复数）；study 的第三人称单数
examples: Studies suggest a strong link. 研究表明存在强关联。

lexicon.sense: 研究、调查；学习 / 研究、学习
examples: The study tracked 200 teenagers. 这项研究追踪了 200 名青少年。

lexicon.sense: suffer 的第三人称单数（遭受）
examples: Local farming suffers under the policy. 当地农业在该政策下受损。
They'll adapt quickly. 他们会很快适应。
Could the same thing happen to crops? 同样的事会发生在作物上吗？
Many think the risk is small. 很多人认为风险很小。

lexicon.sense: 真实的；真正的；符合事实的
examples: This is true in education too. 这在教育上也成立。

lexicon.sense: understand 的过去式与过去分词（理解）
examples: The finding is understood as a warning. 这一发现被理解为警示。
Stanford University scholars studied the data. 斯坦福大学的学者研究了这些数据。

lexicon.sense: use 的过去式/过去分词；（be used to）习惯于；（used to）过去常常
examples: They used flexible work arrangements. 他们使用了弹性工作安排。

lexicon.sense: 想要（want to do / want sb to do）；需要
examples: They want to appear more adult. 他们想显得更成熟。

lexicon.sense: 方法、方式；路；程度（in a way）
collocations: the best way to do sth
examples: There is no simple way to fix it. 没有简单的办法解决它。
In some ways the risks are overstated. 某些方面风险被夸大了。
He is trying to lose weight. 他在努力减重。

lexicon.sense: 好地（副词）；健康的（形容词）；井（名词）
examples: Social health matters to overall well-being. 社交健康关系到整体幸福。

lexicon.sense: what is 或 what has 的缩写
examples: They know what's going on among friends. 他们知道朋友之间在发生什么。
Social support—whether from friends or family—helps. 社会支持——无论来自朋友还是家人——都有帮助。
In other words, the more we believe in effort... 换句话说，我们越相信努力……

lexicon.sense: 工作；运转、奏效 / 工作、作品
examples: The approach works in practice. 这个方法在实践中奏效。

lexicon.sense: 工作的（形容词）；work 的现在分词
examples: Working parents need flexible hours. 职场父母需要弹性工时。

lexicon.sense: 写作、文字（不可数）；write 的现在分词
examples: Teaching formal writing is still crucial. 教正式写作仍然关键。
Red Rum returned the very next year. 「红朗姆」在第二年又回来了。

lexicon.sense: 尚、还（否定/疑问句）；然而（连词）
examples: Yet studies suggest these anxieties are misplaced. 然而研究表明这些焦虑没有根据。
